blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.
blocks.zh: 研究思想创新是科学进步的根本动力,然而仍然难以以可伸缩和可控的方式产生和评价. 这一挑战在于其固有的无限制和多重目标的性质,即各种想法应平衡新颖性、可信性和可行性。 虽然最近基于LLM的方法通过精心设计的提示或代理管道取得了进展,但它们受到预先确定的静态思想工作流程的限制。 为了解决这个局限性,我们提议MindFlow,这个框架明确提出思想作为Mind的图形结构流,它由模块思维操作员组成,由概率思维超网模拟. 鉴于一个研究课题,一个控制器动态地采样思考流来生成候选的想法. 这个开放式问题采用基于锦标赛的相对排名来优化,使控制器逐渐倾向于更高质量的思维流. 我们进一步采用了一项评价协议,联合评估问题发现和解决问题,超越了所有权或抽象判断。 在许多主题上,MindFlow显示出它作为一个明确,可控和可选择的研究思想创新者的优越性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Research idea innovation ( Toubia, 2006 ; Paulus and Yang, 2000 ) is a central driver of scientific progress that involves identifying meaningful gaps, proposing testable hypotheses, and designing viable approaches under real-world constraints.
Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential to accelerate scientific discovery ( Yamada et al., 2025 ; Gottweis et al., 2025 ; Baek et al., 2024b ; Mitchener et al., 2025 ) , including retrieving related works ( Ajith et al., 2024 ; Press et al., 2024 ) , generating code to solve analytical or computational tasks ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2024 ) , and assisting scientists in writing proofs ( Collins et al., 2024 ) .
However, when it comes to research ideation, which is one of the more creative and challenging parts of the research process, LLMs often struggle to produce diverse, high-quality research ideas ( Si et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
研究思想创新 (Toubia,2006年;Paulus和Yang,2000年)是科学进步的中心驱动力,涉及查明有意义的差距,提出可验证的假设,以及在现实世界的限制下设计出可行的方法。
大语言模型(LLMs)的近期进步显示出了加速科学发现的巨大潜力(Yamada等,2025;Gottweis等,2025;Baek等,2024b;Mitchener等,2025),包括检索相关著作(Ajith等,2024;Press等,2024),生成了解决分析或计算任务的代码(Huang等,2024;Tian等,2024),并协助科学家提供书面证明(Collins等,2024.).
然而,在研究思想方面,LLMs是研究过程中更具创造性和更具挑战性的部分之一,而LLMs则经常为产生多样化,高质量的研究思想而挣扎(Si等,2024;Jiang等,2025.).

blocks.en:
This challenge arises from two fundamental properties of research idea generation. First, the task is intrinsically open-ended : it unfolds in a vast, weakly structured search space where research problems are not predefined, and innovation emerges from the joint ability to discover meaningful questions and design viable solutions.
Second, it is multi-objective : novelty should be coupled with additional value, which extends beyond mere fluency or originality to encompass empirical plausibility, feasibility under realistic constraints, and potential scientific impact.
As a result, generating and evaluating research ideas at scale with consistent quality and controllability remains difficult.
blocks.zh:
这一挑战产生于研究思想生成的两个基本特性。 首先,这项任务是内在的开放式的:它在一个广阔而结构薄弱的搜索空间展开,其中研究问题没有预先确定,创新产生于共同发现有意义的问题和设计可行的解决方案的能力。
第二,这是多目标性:新颖性应伴之以额外价值,这种价值超越单纯的流利性或独创性,而包括经验可信性、现实限制下的可行性和潜在的科学影响。
因此,在质量和可控制性一致的情况下,在规模上产生和评价研究想法仍然是困难的。

blocks.en:
A natural response has been to steer LLMs via prompting strategies such as chain-of-ideas prompting ( Li et al., 2024 ) , iterative novelty boosting ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , and retrieve-and-revise pipelines ( Yang et al., 2024 ) .
More recently, agentic pipelines have been proposed to further extend ideation capacity through tool use and multi-agent collaboration ( Si et al., 2024 ; Baek et al., 2024b ; Su et al., 2025 ) .
However, they rely on predefined, static agent workflows, leaving the core thinking process largely implicit, thereby limiting structured exploration over diverse reasoning flows and the ability to compose and reuse partial flows to form new ones.
blocks.zh:
一种自然的反应是引导LLMS,通过诸如 " 思想链 " 推动(Li等,2024年), " 迭接式新颖提振 " (Wang等,2024年a)等激励战略,以及回收再审管道。 (杨等,2024).
最近,有人提议通过工具使用和多剂协作进一步扩大试探能力(Si等人,2024年;Baek等人,2024年b;Su等人,2025年)。
然而,它们依赖于预先定义的,静态的代理工作流程,使得核心思维过程在很大程度上隐含,从而限制了结构化的探索,超越了多样的推理流,限制了将部分流编曲和再利用形成新流的能力.

blocks.en:
In this work, we argue that rather than executing ideation in a fixed pipeline, it is desirable to make the thinking process explicit, controllable, and optimizable , as shown in Fig. 1 . In particular, it should:
(i) explicitly represent ideation as a structured compositional program of atomic thinking operators (e.g., critical thinking, counterfactual thinking).
(ii) adaptively select and compose suitable operators according to different topics, rather than following a one-size-fits-all workflow;
(iii) be optimizable to achieve high-quality operator composition under open-ended, multi-objective evaluation, even allowing user-defined optimization objectives.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们主张,与其在固定的管道中执行想法,不如使思维过程明确、可控和可选择,如图1所示。 它尤其应:
(一)明确代表思想是原子思维操作者(如批判性思维,反事实思维)的结构化组成方案.
(二) 根据不同的专题,而不是遵循 " 一刀切 " 的工作流程,以适应性的方式选择和组成合适的操作员;
(三)可以选取,在开放的多目标评价下实现高质量的运营商构成,甚至允许用户定义的优化目标.

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose MindFlow , mind supernet-powered thinking flows for research idea innovation.
We first explicitly formulate the ideation process as a graph-structured thinking flow, which is composed of mooudular thinking operators that reflect distinct creative modes of human ideation.
To support efficient optimization, we then introduce the concept of mind supernet , which parameterizes a large family of thinking flows in a probabilistic way. Given a research topic, a controller samples a tailored thinking flow and executes it to produce candidate research ideas.
To address the open-ended reward challenge, we employ tournament-based relative ranking, which supplies stable comparative feedback, thereby enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows.
In this way, MindFlow makes the ideation process explicit, controllable and enables topic-aware selection and optimization of these flows, thereby allowing structured exploration and recombination.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提出MindFlow, 思维超网络驱动的思维流用于研究创意。
我们首先明确提出思想过程,作为图形结构的思维流,由能反映人类思想的不同创造性模式的模态思维操作者组成.
为了支持高效的优化,我们引入了"心灵超网"的概念,这个概念将思维的庞大家族以概率化的方式流动. 鉴于一个研究课题,一个控制员对一个量身定制的思维流进行抽样,并进行执行,以产生候选的研究想法.
为了应对无限制的奖励挑战,我们采用基于锦标赛的相对排名,提供稳定的比较反馈,从而使控制者能逐渐地倾向于更高质量的思维流.
这样,MindFlow使构思过程变得清晰,可控并能够对这些流进行有主题意识的选择和优化,从而允许有结构的探索和重组.

blocks.en: Finally, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation protocol for ideation that jointly assesses the abilities of problem finding and problem solving by judging the generated structured proposals. For the multi-objective nature, we further design a suite of dimension-specific metrics and aggregate them into an overall IDEA multi-objective Score . Across diverse topics, MindFlow yields consistent improvements in all-around idea quality compared to strong agentic baselines, while enabling explicit control over the thinking process.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们提出了一套关于思想的全面评价议定书,通过判断所产生的结构化建议,共同评估发现和解决问题的能力。 为了多目标性质,我们进一步设计一套针对具体维度的衡量标准,并将其汇总成一个整体的EIDO多目标分数。 与强有力的代理基线相比,MindFlow在各种专题下,在全方位思想质量方面不断提高,同时能够对思维过程进行明确的控制。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We explicitly formulate research ideation as a graph-structured flow, composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. • We propose MindFlow, a mind supernet-based framework that adaptively allocates and evolves powerful thinking flows according to the given topic. • We develop a comprehensive evaluation protocol for research ideation that jointly assesses the abilities of problem finding and problem solving. Experiments show that MindFlow outperforms baselines across multiple dimensions of idea quality.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Research Idea Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 研究思想的产生

blocks.en: Before the widespread adoption of large language models, concept-level hypothesis generation commonly represented scientific knowledge as entities and relations extracted from the literature and cast hypotheses as candidate links between concepts. Representative approaches employ distributional semantics or graph-based link prediction over literature-derived knowledge graphs ( Nadkarni et al., 2021 ; Sybrandt et al., 2020 ) , which enables the identification of plausible latent relations ( Tshitoyan et al., 2019 ) . These methods are effective in producing high-recall candidates, yet their outputs are often insufficiently specified, typically limited to abstract concept pairs.
blocks.zh: 在大语言模型被广泛采用之前,概念层面的假说生成通常代表科学知识,作为从文献中提取的实体和关系,并将假说作为概念之间的候选联系. 代表性方法采用分布语义或以图表为基础的对文献衍生知识图的预测(Nadkarni等,2021;Sybrandt等,2020),从而能够识别可能存在的潜在关系(Tshitoyan等,2019)。 这些方法在产生高召回候选人方面是有效的,但其产出往往没有得到充分说明,通常仅限于抽象的概念配对.

blocks.en:
With the development of large language models, an increasing body of work has examined their role in hypothesis discovery and research ideation. Early studies demonstrate that LLMs can propose hypotheses in a zero-shot setting ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent systems improve grounding and relevance by incorporating literature retrieval, structured prompting, and iterative refinement. For example, PaperRobot incrementally drafts scientific text conditioned on predicted entities ( Wang et al., 2019 ) ; SciMON performs iterative revisions with an explicit objective related to novelty ( Wang et al., 2023 ) ; and MOOSE leverages multi-level self-feedback to support hypothesis discovery in social science contexts ( Yang et al., 2023 ) .
Although these approaches are more expressive than concept-level link prediction, many focus primarily on hypothesis discovery, which
does not capture the broader structure of a research idea, including problem formulation, methodological design, and experimental protocol.
blocks.zh:
随着大型语言模型的发展,越来越多的工作研究了它们在假说发现和研究思想中的作用. 早期的研究表明,LLMS可以在零射入设定中提出假设(周等,2024. 随后的系统通过纳入文献检索、有条理的催化和迭代的完善,改善了基础和相关性。 例如,PaperRobot以预测的实体为条件逐步起草科学文本(Wang等,2019年);SciMON进行迭接修订,明确目标与新颖性相关(Wang等,2023年);MOOSE利用多层次的自食其力,支持社会科学背景下的假说发现(Yang等,2023年).
虽然这些方法比概念层面的关联预测更具表达性,但许多方法主要侧重于假说发现,即:
无法捕捉到研究思想的更广阔结构,包括问题拟订、方法设计和实验协议。

blocks.en:
To better support multi-step elaboration and refinement, agent-based frameworks introduce explicit decomposition, critique, and collaboration.
ResearchAgent ( Baek et al., 2024a ) employs multiple LLM agents to iteratively propose and review research problems, methods, and experimental designs.
Chain-of-Ideas ( Li et al., 2024 ) models ideation as traversing evolution chains that reflect the development of ideas within a field.
From a human-centered perspective, IdeaSynth ( Pu et al., 2025 ) supports human-LLM collaboration by decomposing ideas into facets and iteratively refining them with literature-grounded feedback.
VIRSCI ( Su et al., 2025 ) further demonstrates that coordinating multiple LLM agents can improve the overall quality of generated scientific ideas.
Despite these advances, most systems still rely on hand-crafted, fixed agent workflows ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . As a result, the ideation process is hard to adapt or optimize for different topics and multi-objective trade-offs and often degenerates into heuristic, prompt-driven iterations.
blocks.zh:
为了更好地支持多步骤的拟订和完善,以代理人为基础的框架引入了明确的分解、批评和协作。
ResearchAgent(Baek等,2024a)使用多种LLM剂来迭代地提出并审查研究问题,方法和实验设计.

从以人为中心的角度来看,IdeaSynth(Pu等,2025年)支持人与LLM合作,将思想分解为几个方面,并用以文献为基础的反馈反复地加以完善.
VIRSCI(Su等人,2025年)进一步表明,协调多种LLM剂可以提高所生成科学思想的整体质量.
尽管取得了这些进步,但大多数系统仍然依赖于手工而固定的代理工作流程(张等,2024;张等,2025. 因此,对于不同的话题和多目标的取舍,思想过程很难适应或优化,常常会退化为高压,即时驱动的迭代.

blocks.en: 2.2 Research Idea Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.2 研究思想评价

blocks.en:
Research idea evaluation has long been a challenging problem, as research ideas are inherently open-ended, multi-dimensional, and rely on deep domain expertise.
Early approaches primarily relied on LLMs ( Si et al., 2024 ) , but faced significant challenges regarding scalability and consistency in judging multifaceted concepts ( Kumar et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2024 ) .
To introduce computed metrics, subsequent research adopted quantitative metrics based on bibliometric data, such as measuring similarity to authentic conference concepts ( Wang et al., 2024b ) or calculating historical difference and contemporary influence ( Su et al., 2024 ) . However, these methods merely analyze paper abstracts ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , often omitting the detailed experimental designs necessary for comprehensive feasibility analysis.
To address these limitations, recent frameworks have moved toward ground-truth and reference-based validation ( Qiu et al., 2025 ) , comparing generated ideas against expert-vetted ideas from accepted papers.
blocks.zh:
研究思想评价长期以来是一个具有挑战性的问题,因为研究思想本质上是开放式的,多维的,并依赖于深领域的专门知识.
早期方法主要依靠LLMs(Si等人,2024年),但在判断多方面概念的可伸缩性和一致性方面面临重大挑战(Kumar等人,2025年;Su等人,2024年)。
为了引入计算度量衡,随后的研究采用了以比比分计量数据为基础的定量度量衡,例如测量与真实会议概念的相似性(Wang等,2024b)或计算历史差异和当代影响(Su等,2024). 然而,这些方法仅仅分析了纸质摘要(Guo等人,2025年),往往省略了全面可行性分析所需的详细实验设计.
为了克服这些局限性,最近的框架已转向地面真相和基于参考的验证(邱等,2025年),将所产生的想法同经专家审查的公认文件的想法进行比较。

blocks.en:
In this section, we propose MindFlow, the Mind supernet-powered thinking Flow s for research idea innovation. The overview framework is shown in Figure 2 .
We first formalize research idea generation as a graph-structured thinking flow composed of atomic thinking operators
(Section 4.1 ).
This explicit formulation transforms the idea-thinking process from a black box into an optimizable object, enabling us to improve ideas by optimizing how they are produced.
To support efficient optimization, we introduce the concept of mind supernet, which parameterizes a large family of thinking flows and assigns learnable selection probabilities (Section 4.2 ).
For each given topic, MindFlow leverages a controller to sample a subnetwork (i.e., a concrete thinking flow) from the mind supernet (Section 4.3 ).
After executing the sampled flow, MindFlow collects tournament-based relative feedback and optimizes the supernet’s parameterized distribution (Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们提出MindFlow,即Mind超网络动力思维流 s,用于研究思想创新. 概览框架见图2。
我们首先将研究思想的产生正式化,作为由原子思维操作者组成的图结构思维流.
(第4.1节)
这种明确的表述方式将思想思维过程从黑匣子转变为可选择的对象,使我们能够通过优化思想产生方式来改进思想.
为了支持高效的优化,我们引入了"心灵超网"的概念,这个概念将思维流动的大家族参数化,并分配出可学习的选择概率(第4.2节).
对于每个给定的话题,MindFlow利用一个控制器从心灵超网(第4.3节)中抽取出一个子网络(即具体的思维流).
MindFlow执行被采样的流后,收集了基于锦标赛的相对反馈并优化了超级网的参数化分布(第4.4节).

blocks.en: 4.1 Graph-structured Thinking Flow Formulation
blocks.zh: 4.1 图结构思维流程的制定

blocks.en:
Inspired by the view that creativity emerges from the composition and recombination of different cognitive primitives ( Boden, 2004 ) , we propose a set of atomic thinking operators and reformulate the research ideation process as a graph-structured thinking flow.
We described the definitions of “thinking operator” and “thinking flow” as follows.
blocks.zh:
受不同认知原始物的构成和再融合(Boden,2004年)所产生的创造力的启发,我们提出一套原子思维操作器,并重订研究思想过程为图结构思维流.
我们描述了“思考操作者”和“思考流动”的定义如下。

blocks.en:
A Thinking Operator O O is an atomic, reusable module that performs a specific cognitive function (e.g., analogical thinking, critical thinking), which is represented as follows: O = ( P , { Q i } i = 1 m , { T i } i = 1 n ) , \begin{gathered}O=\bigl(P,\{Q_{i}\}_{i=1}^{m},\ \{T_{i}\}_{i=1}^{n}\bigr),\\
\end{gathered} (3)

It is represented as a structured LLM-agent routine that integrates operator-specific prompts P P , multi-step LLM executions Q Q , and tool calls T T when available, where both the LLM and tools may be invoked multiple times and interleaved as needed.
We then instantiate the operator library 𝕆 \mathbb{O} with the following operators (details in Appendix B ): • Generate O gen O_{\text{gen}} : produces an initial idea, serving as the default proposal operator. • Divergent Thinking O div O_{\text{div}} : expands the search space by generating diverse alternatives. • Convergent Thinking O conv O_{\text{conv}} : narrows down candidates by synthesizing, ranking, and selecting promising elements to form a coherent, high-quality proposal. • Critical Thinking O crit O_{\text{crit}} : stress-tests an idea via critique and verification, raising potential issues and iteratively refining the proposal with targeted fixes. • Analogical Thinking O ana O_{\text{ana}} : transfers structure from related problems to propose new formulations or solution routes, optionally aided by retrieval tools. • Counterfactual Thinking O cf O_{\text{cf}} : explores “what-if” variations by perturbing key assumptions. • Constraint-Driven Thinking O con O_{\text{con}} : generates or repairs ideas under explicit constraints.

blocks.en: 4.4 Tournament-based Relative Ranking for Supernet Optimization
blocks.zh: 4.4 超级网最佳化基于锦标赛的相对排名

blocks.en:
Many RL optimizers ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) in general tasks assume access to a reliable scalar reward that provides accurate pointwise feedback.
However, for open-ended research ideation, absolute scoring by an LLM judge is often noisy and poorly calibrated, yielding weak discrimination among candidates (i.e., judgment collapse ) ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
To address this limitation, we propose intra-group relative ranking over candidate research ideas as the reward signal.
To reduce the O ⁡ ( K 2 ) O(K^{2}) cost of exhaustive pairwise comparisons, we adopt an anchor-based tournament .

为了解决这一限制,我们提议把集团内部相对于候选研究想法的排名作为奖励信号。

blocks.en: To address the open-ended and multi-objective nature of ideation, we introduce IdeaBench , an AI-paper benchmark that enables scalable evaluation, constructed as follows.

blocks.en: 5.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集

blocks.en:
Our dataset is built upon AI Idea Bench 2025 benchmark ( Qiu et al., 2025 ) ,
which consists of 3,495 oral/spotlight or highlight papers from major CV, NLP, and ML conferences over the past year.
Additionally, we collected the inspirational source papers corresponding to the target papers, from which we constructed input-output pairs for idea generation.
Moreover, we extract the original idea of each target paper into the same format as our system outputs, which serves as the expert-written ground-truth reference in evaluation.
The complete data details are shown in Appendix A .
We then organize these papers into eight topic domains: CV, NLP, Multi-modal, Audio & Speech, Robotics & Control, Science, General ML, and Theory. These papers are then split into training and validation sets using a 70-30 ratio.

此外,我们收集了与目标文件相对应的灵感源文件,我们从中构建出投入-输出对来生成想法.

blocks.en: To evaluate the open-ended nature of idea generation, we adopt a hybrid framework that integrates both LLM judgments and computable metrics.
blocks.zh: 为了评价思想生成的开放性,我们采用了一个混合框架,将LLM判断和可计算量度结合起来。

blocks.en:
We adopt a two-stage protocol with three dimensions per stage. Problem discovery evaluates the problem motivation ( y p y_{p} ) by problem novelty ( s PN s_{\mathrm{PN}} ), significance ( s SIG s_{\mathrm{SIG}} ), and timeliness ( s TIME s_{\mathrm{TIME}} ) relative to the literature ( x r x_{r} ). Problem solving evaluates the method and validation plan ( y m , y e y_{m},y_{e} ) by technical novelty ( s TN s_{\mathrm{TN}} ), effectiveness ( s EFF s_{\mathrm{EFF}} ), and feasibility ( s FEAS s_{\mathrm{FEAS}} ).
We evaluate model-generated ideas via pairwise comparison against expert-written reference ideas (ground truth). Given a pair, an LLM judge selects the better idea. For robustness, we use three different judges and apply order randomization: each judge votes twice with swapped presentation order, yielding six votes per dimension. The win rate against the reference is used as the score for that dimension. The evaluation details are shown in Appendix C .

blocks.en:
In this section, we compare MindFlow with two base models, vanilla Generate and GenerateCoT ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , and three recent agent-based systems for idea generation: the single-agent systems AI Scientist ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , AI-Researcher ( Si et al., 2024 ) and the multi-agent system VIRSCI ( Su et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: 6.1 Performance Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.1 业绩分析

blocks.en: We then evaluate MindFlow under the LLM-judged protocol, with results summarized in Table 1 . Several clear observations emerge. First , MindFlow consistently outperforms vanilla generation baselines and strong agentic systems on the aggregate multi-objective metric , across both problem-finding and problem-solving. Second , in problem finding, many baselines fall into a common pattern: they can generate highly novel motivation but struggle to argue why the problem matters (low significance), or they propose “important” topics that are safe and incremental (low novelty). However, ours outperforms in both metrics. Third , in problem solving, the trade-off becomes even more pronounced between effectiveness/novelty and feasibility. AI Scientists emphasize feasibility but lag in novelty, tending to generate conservative method designs, while VIRSCI is strong on novelty yet sacrifices feasibility. In contrast, MindFlow achieves the best aggregate multi-objective metric , indicating a more balanced optimization across objectives.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们根据LLM审判规程评估MindFlow,结果摘要见表1。 出现了若干明确的意见。 首先,MindFlow在总的多目标衡量尺度上,在发现问题和解决问题方面,其业绩始终超过香草生成基线和强大的活性系统。 其次,在发现问题时,许多基线都属于一个共同的模式:它们可以产生非常新的动机,但会竭力争论问题为何重要(不太重要),或者它们提出安全和渐进的“重要”专题(不太新颖)。 然而,我们的成绩在两个衡量标准上都超过。 第三,在解决问题时,在效力/新颖性和可行性之间作出权衡变得更加明显。 AI 科学家强调可行性,但在新颖性方面落后,倾向于产生保守的方法设计,而VIRSCI则在新颖性方面强而牺牲可行性. 相比之下,MindFlow实现了最佳的聚合多目标度量,表明在目标之间实现更平衡的优化。

blocks.en:
We further report computable metrics for novelty, diversity, effectiveness, and feasibility in Table 2 .
As shown, MindFlow achieves the best performance on all four dimensions, indicating that its improvements are not driven by over-optimizing a single objective.
MindFlow achieves the highest novelty score, suggesting it produces ideas that are more distinct from existing baselines and less likely to collapse into generic formulations.
Notably, beyond improving novelty, MindFlow also increases the diversity of generated ideas by sampling different thinking flows from the mind supernet, enabling exploration of multiple reasoning trajectories rather than committing to a single fixed workflow.
On effectiveness , we measure whether the generated method matches a known expert subset, which provides a reliable lower bound for producing an effective solution. The results suggest that MindFlow’s gains are accompanied by more consistently valid method proposals, rather than being driven by superficial novelty alone.
On feasibility , we assess whether the proposed idea satisfies basic constraints, serving as a practical check on whether an idea can be executed with reasonable resources and standard experimental or computational setups. Experiments show it’s novel ideas that remain feasible, and that exploring multiple thinking flows helps avoid unrealistic proposals that trade feasibility for creativity.

如所显示,MindFlow在所有四个方面都取得了最佳表现,表明其改进并非由一个单一目标的过度优化所驱动.
MindFlow实现最高的新颖分数,建议它产生与现有基准更相区别的想法,更不会被倒塌为通用配方.
值得注意的是,MindFlow除了改进了新颖性外,还通过取样来自心灵超网的不同思维流来增加所产生想法的多样性,使得能够探索多种推理轨迹而不是致力于单一的固定工作流程.
关于有效性,我们衡量生成的方法是否与已知的专家子集相匹配,这为产生有效解决方案提供了可靠的较低约束。 结果表明,MindFlow的收益伴随着更一贯有效的方法建议,而不是仅仅靠表面的新颖性驱动。

blocks.en: To further validate the reliability of our automatic evaluation protocol, we conduct an additional human expert evaluation. We recruit six domain experts with expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision, all of whom have publication records in top-tier venues. We randomly sample 50 queries from IdeaBench and collect the ideas generated by four representative methods: AI Scientist, AI-Researcher, VIRSCI, and MindFlow. For each query, the generated ideas are presented to the experts in a blind and randomized order. Each expert is asked to rank the ideas along the same six dimensions used in LLM-judged evaluation, including problem-formulation novelty, significance, and timeliness, as well as problem-solution novelty, effectiveness, and feasibility.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步验证我们自动评估协议的可靠性,我们进行了额外的人类专家评估。 我们招聘了6位在机器学习、自然语言处理和计算机视觉方面有专长的域名专家,他们都拥有高层场所的出版记录。 我们随机抽取了来自Idea Bench的50个查询,并收集了由四个代表性方法产生的想法:AI科学家,AI-Researcher,VIRSCI,和MindFlow. 对于每个查询,所产生的想法都按盲目和随机排列的顺序向专家介绍. 要求每位专家按照LLM判断的评价所用的相同的六个方面,包括问题拟订新颖性、意义和及时性,以及问题解决新颖性、有效性和可行性,对想法进行排序。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , MindFlow achieves the best overall human evaluation score, leading particularly in both problem-formulation and problem-solution MOScores. This confirms its advantage in generating timely, practically grounded research ideas, which highly aligns with our automated LLM-judge conclusions.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,MindFlow取得了人类总体评价的最佳分数,特别是在问题形成和问题解决MOS分数两方面都领先. 这证实了它在产生及时的、有实际依据的研究想法方面的优势,这些想法与我们自动化的法学硕士结论高度一致。

blocks.en:
We further analyze the reliability of the LLM-judged protocol from two perspectives: inter-judge agreement among the three LLM judges and agreement between human experts and LLM judges.
As shown in Table 4 , the three LLM judges achieve an average inter-judge agreement rate of 74.9% across the six evaluation dimensions. Moreover, the average human–LLM agreement rate reaches 77.8%, indicating that the LLM-based evaluation protocol is generally aligned with expert judgments.
These high alignment rates robustly support our LLM-based protocol as a scalable, reliable proxy for expert human judgment.
blocks.zh:
我们从两个角度进一步分析LLM判决协议的可靠性:三位LLM法官之间的法官协议和人类专家与LLM法官之间的协议。
如表4所示,在六个评价方面,三名法学硕士法官的平均法官协议率为74.9%。 此外,人与LLM协议的平均比率为77.8%,这表明基于LLM的评估协议一般与专家判断一致.
这些高校正率有力地支持了我们基于LLM的协议,作为一个可伸缩的,可靠的人类专家判断的代名词.

blocks.en: 6.2 Framework Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.2 框架分析

blocks.en:
To validate the effectiveness of the proposed mind supernet , we perform an operator-wise ablation by performing each operator. Table 5 shows that no single operator consistently dominates across all dimensions: operators that excel in one aspect often underperform in others, leading to pronounced multi-objective trade-offs in both problem finding and problem solving .
For instance, Counterfactual Thinking attains the highest novelty in both stages but sacrifices significance and feasibility, while Critical Thinking improves significance and feasibility yet yields weaker novelty and overall balance.
By contrast, MindFlow achieves the best MOScores for both problem finding and problem solving, as well as the best overall score, indicating that the supernet-based controller mechanism effectively selects and composes different thinking flows to mitigate these trade-offs.
Overall, these results support our central claim: modeling ideation as a search and optimization problem over a supernet of flows yields more robust, balanced performance than any fixed operator choice.
blocks.zh:
为了验证拟建的心智超网的有效性,我们通过执行每个操作员来进行操作员的减速。 表5显示,没有一个单一经营者在所有方面始终占主导地位:在某一方面表现优异的经营者在另一些方面往往表现不佳,导致在发现问题和解决问题方面明显实现多重目标取舍。
例如,反事实思维在两个阶段都取得了最高的新颖性,但牺牲了意义和可行性,而 " 关键思维 " 则提高了意义和可行性,但提高了新颖性和总体平衡。
相形之下,MindFlow既能实现问题发现和问题解决的最佳MOS分数,也能获得最佳的整体分数,表明基于超级网的控制器机制能有效选择和作曲不同的思维流来缓解这些取舍.
总体而言,这些结果支持了我们的核心主张:将想法模拟成一个搜索和优化问题,凌驾于流量的超级网之上,其性能比任何固定的操作者选择都更强健,更平衡.

blocks.en:
We further analyze performance across eight topic domains in Table 6 . MindFlow consistently outperforms baselines in most domains, with particularly strong gains in Robotics, Theory, and General ML.
These results indicate that MindFlow does not overfit to a specific research area but instead adapts its thinking flow to domain-specific constraints and objectives, demonstrating robust generalization across diverse research topics. More Results are shown in Append E .

我们进一步分析表6八个专题领域的业绩。 MindFlow在大多数领域的业绩都超过基线,在机器人、理论和通用ML方面尤其显著。
这些结果表明,MindFlow并不过于适合特定研究领域,而是将其思维流动适应特定领域的限制和目标,显示出对不同研究专题的强烈概括。 更多结果见附录E。

blocks.en: 6.3 Case Study
blocks.zh: 6.3 个案研究

blocks.en:
In this section, we probe the intrinsic mechanisms learned by the mind supernet and make them interpretable through operator-level visualizations.
Figure 3 visualizes the learned probability distributions over thinking operators under different topics.
Overall, the distributions are far from uniform: instead of sampling operators at fixed rates, the supernet learns structured preferences that vary with query semantics and with depth
The observations are as follows:
First, we observe clear topic-dependent patterns: for example, theory-oriented queries favor critical and constraint-driven thinking, while applied domains allocate higher probability to analogical and divergent thinking operators.
Second, we can see that the probability of the exit operator becomes increasingly high as the supernet depth increases.
Finally, we observe that the operator distributions are not simply single-peaked selections but often exhibit meaningful mixtures, implying that MindFlow composes complementary reasoning modes rather than committing to one dominant operator.
These visualizations provide direct evidence that MindFlow learns to adaptively allocate and compose reasoning strategies, rather than relying on a fixed pattern.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们探索了心灵超网所学取的内在机制,并通过操作者层面的可视化使其可被解释.
图3可视化不同主题下学习到的概率分布相对于思维操作员.
总体而言,分布远非统一: 超网不是以固定的速率对操作员进行采样,而是学习结构化的偏好,这些偏好随查询语义和深度的不同而不同.
意见如下:
首先,我们观察到明确的主题依赖模式:例如,面向理论的查询倾向于批评和约束驱动的思维,而应用域则将更高的概率分配给模拟和分歧的思维操作者.
第二,我们可以看到,随着超级网深度的增加,退出操作员的概率会越来越高.
最后,我们注意到,操作员的分布不仅仅是单峰选择,而往往是显出有意义的混合物,这意味着MindFlow是互补的推理模式,而不是对一个主导操作员的承诺.
这些可视化提供了直接的证据,MindFlow学会了适应性地分配和作曲推理策略,而不是依赖固定的规律.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 结论和限制

blocks.en: Research idea innovation is challenging due to its open-ended and multi-objective nature, where novelty must be balanced with plausibility and feasibility. We propose MindFlow, which formulates ideation as graph-structured thinking flows composed of modular operators and optimized within a probabilistic mind supernet. By dynamically sampling and improving topic-conditioned flows via relative ranking, MindFlow consistently outperforms strong baselines across both problem finding and problem solving, demonstrating the benefit of making the thinking process explicit, controllable, and optimizable. Ultimately, we establish a scalable, human-aligned evaluation paradigm to guide future advancements in automated research.
blocks.zh: 研究思想创新因其开放性和多目标性而具有挑战性,新颖性必须与可信度和可行性相平衡. 我们提出MindFlow,它将思想表达为由模块操作器组成的由图结构思维流,并在概率思维超网中优化. MindFlow通过动态取样和通过相对排名改善专题条件的流量,在发现问题和解决问题两方面都持续超越了强有力的基线,显示了使思维过程明确、可控和可选择的好处。 归根结底,我们建立了一个可扩展、与人相适应的评价范式,以指导今后自动化研究的进展。

blocks.en:
This work has several limitations. First,
research idea evaluation is inherently open-ended and subjective, so ensuring fully fair, consistent, and objective assessment remains a central challenge.
Second, the operator set is manually designed and may not cover all forms of scientific reasoning. Extending MindFlow to learn operators automatically remains future work.
Third, MindFlow currently focuses on generating research ideas at the conceptual level, but does not fully verify their empirical feasibility through experimentation or expert-in-the-loop refinement.
blocks.zh:
这项工作有几个局限性。 首先,
研究思想评价本质上是无限制和主观的,因此确保充分公平、一致和客观的评估仍然是一项核心挑战。
二,操作器集由人工设计,可能不涵盖所有科学推理形式. 将MindFlow扩展为自动学习操作员仍然是未来的工作.
第三点,头脑 流程目前侧重于在概念层面产生研究想法,但并未通过实验或专家入门完善充分验证其经验可行性.

blocks.en: We believe that MindFlow raises no inherent ethical concerns regarding its motivation, design, or implementation. The framework operates entirely on high-level scientific reasoning and idea generation, without involving personal data or sensitive information. MindFlow does not aim to replace human scientific judgment; instead, it serves as a decision-support tool that makes the ideation process more transparent and controllable. By explicitly structuring and evaluating thinking flows, the framework aligns with responsible AI principles that emphasize interpretability, reproducibility, and human oversight.

blocks.en: We compare MindFlow against isolated operators and a stochastic baseline (Shuffle Operator).The empirical results highlight the domain-specific nature of different thinking modes. For example, Analogical Thinking is competitive in CV (0.457), whereas Constraint-Driven Thinking dominates in Robotics (0.628) but underperforms in Audio & Speech (0.237). This variability underscores the limitation of relying on a fixed operator.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了MindFlow和孤立的操作员,以及有条理的基线(Shuffle操作员). 实证结果凸显出不同思维模式的域特有性. 例如,Analogical Thinking在CV(0.457)中具有竞争力,而Constraint-Driven Thinking在机器人学(0.628)中占主导地位,但在Audio & Speech(0.237)中表现不佳. 这种可变性突出了依赖固定操作员的局限性。

blocks.en: The performance gap between MindFlow and the Shuffle Operator specifically validates the efficacy of our controller: it does not merely combine operators,but learns to choose and combine the most effective thinking patterns tailored to each specific input.
blocks.zh: MindFlow和Shuffle操作器之间的性能差距具体验证了我们控制器的功效:它不仅仅结合操作器,而是学会选择和结合适合每个具体输入的最有效的思维模式.
